collection_method.listing: public channel tabs via yt-dlp extract_flat (no watch pages, no media)
collection_method.details: official Atom feeds (/feeds/videos.xml), 15 entries per feed
collection_method.thumbnails: public image CDN, local cache only
not_collected: caption tracks and spoken content (watch pages answer server networks with a sign-in check; not bypassed)
video and audio streams (never downloaded by design)
comment counts, tags and retention data (need the Data API or channel-owner analytics)

cadence.note: Upload days come from the tab listing, where YouTube exposes only a relative date ('3 days ago', '4 months ago', '2 years ago'). Day resolution holds for about a month, month resolution for 11 months; older uploads cannot be dated from the listing.

shorts.note: The Shorts tab listing exposes no dates, so cadence cannot be computed from it.

publish_timing.note: Exact publish times are only exposed by the official feeds (15 entries per feed).

views.note: Listing view counts are rounded by YouTube (e.g. 275K). Videos younger than ~3 days are still accumulating views.

descriptions.note: Descriptions are read from the official feeds; only structural features are stored, not the text.

engagement.note: Like and exact view counts come from the official feeds. Comment counts are not exposed without the Data API.
